process.note: Steps follow Nathan's Economy Read Chain (Releases -> Themes -> Rates & Yields -> Performance). How each print is weighed is still to come.

steps.label: Releases (days): what moved this week in inflation, growth and labour
Themes (weeks): does the growth / inflation / labour diagnosis change
Which is the scare: inflation, growth, both or neither
Rates & Yields (months): policy rate, 2Y / 10Y, what the central bank is forced to do
Performance: rank, 2Y vs policy, has price caught up with the read (the gap)

overview.headline: Divergence widening: inflation-scare economies vs growth-scare economies. NZD weakest, GBP strongest.
bullets: Inflation scare: USD, GBP, AUD, JPY. Growth scare: EUR, CAD, NZD, CHF.
Divergence trade: hawkish-gap currencies vs growth-scare currencies.
Oil and gas moves are the main driver conflicts (CAD, EUR).

economies.name: United States
economies.verdict: Inflation is still the scare. Jobs beat pushed pricing toward my path but gap remains.

takeaways: ISM services prices paid still elevated

economies.name: Euro area
economies.verdict: Growth is the scare. Gas collapse muddies the picture short term.

takeaways: ECB speakers open to December cut

economies.name: United Kingdom

takeaways: GBP crowded long: pricing kill switch near
